# v1.1.0-dev.109: The bar stays, and the clicks land

Pre-release off the `dev` branch. Builds on `v1.1.0-dev.108`.

## The title bar keeps its height

A virtual window's title bar no longer slims down when something is docked
into it. It stays the height it had empty. Docked windows sit a little lower
in the container as a result, and the bar's buttons keep their size instead
of shrinking to fit an 18px strip.

## A docking window can't eat your clicks

Between hiding a fully docked window and clipping it to its pane there was a
gap where the invisible window still answered clicks over its whole
rectangle: the container's own title bar, the splitters, and whatever the
window covered where it was dropped. That gap is closed. The window is made
click-through everywhere before it is hidden, moved onto its pane, and only
then clipped to the pane and drawn as a picture. A window that refuses the
clip is left visible as an ordinary docked window instead of being hidden
behind it, and an app that hangs mid-dock can no longer wedge the machinery.

## A closed docked window leaves a clean pane

When an app closes its own docked window, its pane now shows the "not
running" placeholder and the title bar stops counting it right away, instead
of the pane sitting blank until the next time the container moves.

## Loading a profile with docked windows reports back

The first Load of a profile with anything docked in it loaded the layout and
then errored back to the app window instead of reporting what it did, so the
status line stayed on "Loading...". Fixed.

## Smaller fixes

- Maximizing a virtual window re-asks Windows for its frame, the same
  treatment the app window already had for maximize rendering glitches.
- Where a container lands after minimize and restore is now measured by a
  probe, after one report of it landing misplaced on a mixed-DPI desk.

## Install

Auto-updates from dev.53 and later. Otherwise unzip and run.
